# Kenson Parenting Solutions

> Kenson Parenting Solutions provides behavior management and incentive tools including reward charts, potty training systems, and classroom management products for children ages 3-10.

Founded by Kenson Kids, this North Carolina-based company specializes in positive reinforcement products for parents, teachers, and homeschoolers. Their flagship "I Can Do It!" reward chart system helps track behavior, manage daily checklists, and support children with autism and ADHD through visual incentive systems.

- I Can Do It! Reward Chart

## Flagship Products

- ["I Can Do It!" Reward Star Chart by Kenson Kids](https://www.kensonparenting.com/collections/frontpage/products/i-can-do-it-reward-chart): Flagship I Can Do It reward chart for ages 3-10 with behavior tracking
- [I Can Do It! Star Token Board Dry Erase Classroom Incentive Chart](https://www.kensonparenting.com/collections/frontpage/products/i-can-do-it-token-board): Classroom token board for individual behavior goals and autism-friendly support
- [Kenson Kids "I Can Do It" Reward Charts](https://www.kensonparenting.com/collections/reward-charts): Flagship reward chart collection for behavior tracking and positive reinforcement

## Specialized Solutions

- [Potty Training charts – Kenson Parenting Solutions](https://www.kensonparenting.com/collections/potty-training): Specialized potty training charts and motivational products for toddlers
